get.description: Retrieves attendance records for the specified teacher. Supports optional date range filtering using fromDate and toDate query parameters.
Retrieves a list of points awarded by the specified teacher. Can be filtered to a specific semester using the semesterId query parameter.

post.description: Uploads and attaches a file (such as a document or photo) to the specified teacher's profile.

get.description: Retrieves metadata for all file attachments associated with the specified teacher.
Retrieves a paginated and filtered list of teachers. Supports filtering by class (halaqa), semester, and course.
Retrieves the full profile of a specific teacher by their unique identifier.

put.description: Partially updates teacher profile/account fields. Only provided fields are changed; password is hashed before saving.

delete.description: Permanently removes a teacher and all their associated data from the system.

post.description: Registers a new teacher in the system. The teacher's national ID number is used as the default password. Use the POST /{id}/attachments endpoint to upload files separately.

put.description: Changes the login password for the specified teacher account.

post.description: Assigns a teacher to a specific class (halaqa). Use the isMainTeacher flag to designate this teacher as the primary teacher for the class.

get.description: Retrieves all class (halaqa) assignments for the specified teacher.
Retrieves all halaqas (study circles) assigned to the currently authenticated teacher.
Retrieves all halaqas (study circles) the specified teacher is assigned to, including course (subject) details such as Quran, Hadith, etc.

get.summary: Get Students with Attendance in Halaqa
get.description: Retrieves all students enrolled in the specified halaqa along with their attendance records.

post.description: Allows the teacher to confirm (record) attendance for a student in a halaqa session by providing the student enrollment ID and session date range.
Adds a point-based assessment for a student in a specific subject (course). Use a positive PointValue to add points and a negative value to deduct points. Supports optional category and notes.

get.description: Retrieves a student's point-based assessments grouped by subject (course: Quran, Hadith, etc.). Supports optional filtering by class or semester.
Retrieves all students enrolled in any of the teacher's halaqas. Supports optional name search via the 'nameSearch' query parameter.
Retrieves the assigned academic stage for the specified student.

put.description: Updates the assigned academic stage for the specified student.

get.description: Retrieves the memorized Quran parts assigned to the specified student.

put.description: Replaces the memorized Quran parts assigned to the specified student.

get.description: Retrieves the Quran memorization progress records for the specified student.
Retrieves attendance records for the specified student. Supports optional date range filtering using fromDate and toDate query parameters.
Retrieves all points earned by the specified student. Can be filtered to a specific semester using the semesterId query parameter.

post.description: Uploads and attaches a file (such as a document or photo) to the specified student's profile.

get.description: Retrieves metadata for all file attachments associated with the specified student.
Packages all file attachments for the specified student into a ZIP archive and returns it as a downloadable file.
Retrieves a paginated and filtered list of students. Supports filtering by class (halaqa), semester, course, and teacher.
Retrieves the full profile of a specific student by their unique identifier.

put.description: Partially updates student profile/account fields. Only provided fields are changed; password is hashed before saving.

delete.description: Permanently removes a student and all their associated data from the system.

post.description: Registers a new student in the system. The student's national ID number is used as the default password. Optional profile photos can be uploaded as part of the same request.

put.description: Changes the login password for the specified student account.

post.description: Enrolls a student into a specific class (halaqa) by their unique identifiers.

get.description: Retrieves all class (halaqa) enrollments for the specified student.
Retrieves a comprehensive attendance report for all students and teachers within the specified date range (defaults to the current month).
Retrieves a paginated attendance report for all students within the specified date range. Supports pagination via page and pageSize query parameters.
Retrieves a paginated attendance report for all teachers within the specified date range. Supports pagination via page and pageSize query parameters.
Retrieves a high-level attendance summary (totals and rates) for both students and teachers within the specified date range.
Retrieves an attendance overview for a specific day (defaults to today).
Retrieves an attendance overview for a full week starting on the given weekStart date (defaults to the current week).
Retrieves an attendance overview for the specified month and year (defaults to the current month).
Retrieves a combined activity report for a class on a specific day, covering attendance, memorization, and points.
Retrieves a class's aggregated activity report for a specific week (defaults to the current week).
Retrieves a class's aggregated activity report for the specified month and year (defaults to the current month).
Retrieves a comprehensive performance report for a class during the specified semester.
Retrieves an attendance summary for all students in the specified class. Supports optional date range filtering with fromDate and toDate.
Retrieves a points summary for all students in the specified class. Can be filtered to a specific semester using the semesterId query parameter.
Retrieves a Quran memorization progress summary for all students in the specified class.
Retrieves a comprehensive overview of all points awarded across all students and categories, optionally filtered by semester or date range.
Retrieves a high-level summary of total points awarded across all categories, optionally filtered by semester or date range.
Retrieves a paginated breakdown of points earned by each student, optionally filtered by semester or date range.
Retrieves a paginated breakdown of points awarded by each teacher, optionally filtered by semester or date range.
Retrieves a breakdown of total points awarded by category (Quran, Hadith, Attendance, Behavior), optionally filtered by semester or date range.
Retrieves the highest-scoring students by total points earned. Use the top query parameter to control the number of results (default: 10).

get.summary: Get Top Teachers by Points Given
get.description: Retrieves the teachers who have awarded the most points. Use the top query parameter to control the number of results (default: 10).
Retrieves a points overview for a specific day (defaults to today).
Retrieves a points overview for a full week starting on the given weekStart date (defaults to the current week).
Retrieves a points overview for the specified month and year (defaults to the current month).
Retrieves a comprehensive overview report for a semester, including overall statistics, top-performing students and teachers, and class summaries.
Retrieves key numerical statistics for the specified semester, such as total students, attendance rates, and point totals.
Retrieves the top-performing students for the specified semester. Use the top query parameter to control how many results to return (default: 10).
Retrieves the top-performing teachers for the specified semester. Use the top query parameter to control how many results to return (default: 10).
Retrieves summary reports for all halaqas (classes) within the specified semester.
Retrieves a comprehensive performance report for a student for a specific day, including attendance, memorization, and points earned.
Retrieves a student's aggregated performance report for a specific week starting on the given weekStart date (defaults to the current week).
Retrieves a student's aggregated performance report for the specified month and year (defaults to the current month).
Retrieves a comprehensive report for a student's performance during the specified semester, including attendance, memorization, and total points.
Retrieves combined daily, weekly, monthly, and/or semester reports for a student in a single call. Use the periodType parameter to select which report types to include.
Downloads a student's daily report as a file. Supports JSON and XML formats via the format query parameter (defaults to JSON).
Retrieves a teacher's activity report for a specific day, including sessions conducted and attendance recorded.
Retrieves a teacher's aggregated activity report for a specific week (defaults to the current week).
Retrieves a teacher's aggregated activity report for the specified month and year (defaults to the current month).
Retrieves a comprehensive performance report for a teacher during the specified semester.
Retrieves a paginated breakdown of points awarded by the specified teacher. Supports filtering by semester and date range.
Retrieves the academic progress of all students currently or previously taught by the specified teacher. Supports pagination and semester filtering.

delete.description: Permanently removes a manager account from the system.

get.description: Retrieves a complete list of all forms in the system.

post.description: Creates a new form with the specified settings, type (survey or quiz), scheduling, and visibility options.

get.description: Retrieves a paginated list of forms. Use the page and pageSize query parameters to control pagination.
Retrieves a specific form by its unique identifier. Requires authentication.

put.description: Updates the details and settings of an existing form.

delete.description: Permanently removes a form and all its associated questions and responses from the system.

get.description: Retrieves a publicly shared form using its unique access token. Returns 401 Unauthorized for quiz-type forms accessed by unauthenticated users, and 400 Bad Request if the form is inactive or outside its scheduled time window.
Retrieves all questions across all forms in the system.

post.description: Adds a new question to the specified form.

get.description: Retrieves a specific form question by its unique identifier.

put.description: Updates the text, order, or type of an existing form question.

delete.description: Permanently removes a question from a form, along with all its answer options.

get.description: Retrieves all questions that belong to the specified form.

get.summary: Get Form Question Option by ID
get.description: Retrieves a specific answer option for a form question by its unique identifier.

put.description: Updates the text or properties of an existing answer option.

delete.description: Permanently removes an answer option from a form question.

get.description: Retrieves all answer options for the specified form question.

post.description: Adds a new answer option to the specified form question.

get.description: Retrieves a specific form submission response by its unique identifier.

delete.description: Permanently removes a form submission response from the system.

get.description: Retrieves all submission responses for the specified form.

post.description: Submits a user's answers to a form. Available to anonymous users for non-quiz forms. Quiz-type forms require authentication.

put.description: Updates the details of an existing academic course.

delete.description: Permanently removes a course and all its associated halaqas from the system.

get.description: Retrieves all halaqas (classes) that belong to the specified course.
Retrieves a specific halaqa (class) by its unique identifier.

put.description: Updates the details of an existing halaqa (class).

delete.description: Permanently removes a halaqa (class) from the system.
